title: Players Introduction Form (KPSSA)
text:
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
 STATE DEPARTMENT OF EARLY LEARNING AND BASIC EDUCATION
 KENYA PRIMARY SCHOOLS SPORTS ASSOCIATION (KPSSA)
 PLAYER’S INTRODUCTORY FORM
S/NO DESCRIPTION PLAYERS INFORMATION
 1. NAME
2. GENDER
3. DATE OF BIRTH
4. BIRTH CERTIFICATE NUMBER
5. DISCIPLINE
6. SCHOOL
7. SUB COUNTY
8. COUNTY
9. REGION
10. HEAD TEACHER’S NAME
11. HEAD TEACHER’S T.S.C NUMBER
12. HEAD TEACHER’S PHONE NO.
13. HEAD TEACHER’S SIGNATURE
  Kindly attach the following documents to this intro form for completion
 a) Certified photocopy of birth certificate
 b) Certified photo of the player with the Headteacher (No group photo)
 SCHOOL OFFICIAL RUBBER STAMP/DATE
